posts.text: Enzo on his start to life as City manager 🗣️

Enzo 💬 (On facing Sunderland) I have the feeling that Sunderland game will be the toughest game since we started the season.

I watched them already in the last two days, three or four games. I know them already. I know how strong they are, and I have the feeling that on Sunday we need a top performance to beat them, and we need to be 100% to win the game.
Enzo 💬 (On Jérémy Doku's fitness) Probably he can be available for Sunderland.
Nothing but respect for a strike like that 👏

Elliot Anderson, Marc Guéhi and Nico O'Reilly have been named in Thomas Tuchel's @England squad for their upcoming Nations League fixtures! 🦁

Congratulations, lads 🩵
All 8 Premier League teams have won their European games so far this season 🙌

The fans said “SHOOT”…

Liam Delap listened. 🫡
